title: Normalization projective components
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $C$ a projective $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-kun-projective]. Let $N\to C$ be the normalization, meaning the disjoint union of the normalizations [def-sc-normalization] of the reduced irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction, lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Then $N\to C$ is finite and surjective [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $N$ is projective and proper over $k$, and $N=\coprod_{i\in I}N_i$ for a finite set $I$, where each $N_i$ is nonempty, normal (every local ring is an integrally closed domain), integral and both open and closed in $N$ [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion]. Each $N_i$ is projective and proper over $k$. If $\dim C\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], then $\dim N_i\le1$ for all $i$. The map $N\to C$ factors through $C_{\mathrm{red}}$ as its normalization. The set $I$ is empty if and only if $C$ is empty.
